P0-A2.title: Engine core: arithmetic, boards, the two moves, errors, caps, golden harness
P0-A2.summary: The phase-0 engine of SPEC 5: the Arith interface with SafeInt and Big, the Board type with labels, cartan() for every finite family at any rank, boardFromName for finite names, fromAdjacency/adjacency, boardKind, toLabels/toPositions, mutate and fire, every error class of E-10, the caps module, and the golden-test harness implementing the seven comparison rules of 5.7 with a coverage registry; the phase-0 golden tests for all 32 types; property test 1; unit tests for labels on an affine-labelled board and for SafeInt overflow.
owns: packages/engine/src/arith.ts, errors.ts, caps.ts, board.ts, moves.ts, index.ts
deliverables: arith.ts: Arith<T>, SafeInt (every add/sub/mul result checked with Number.isSafeInteger; throws EngineOverflow), Big; show() as decimal text; toBig()
errors.ts: EngineError base; NotABoard, NeedsTwoWayRoads, NeedsConnectedBoard, NotFiniteType, NotAffine, NotAdmissible, EngineOverflow
caps.ts: the constants of CONTRACTS 2.3

board.ts: Board<T>; cartan(name) for A(n>=1), B(n>=2), C(n>=2), D(n>=4), E6/E7/E8, F4, G2 in Bourbaki numbering (SPEC 2.8) with the reference matrices of 2.8 reproduced; boardFromName for finite names (SafeInt, labels 1..n, name set); fromAdjacency (C = 2I - A^T) and adjacency; boardKind; toLabels/toPositions; cartanNumbers
moves.ts: mutate (only entry i changes) and fire (negate a_i, neighbours a_j -= C[j][i] a_i), generic over Arith
_harness.ts: everything in CONTRACTS section 3 including GOLDEN_KEYS_BY_PHASE from the table of SPEC 5.7 and covers() writing test/golden/coverage.json

p0 golden tests: for all 32 types, cartan(name) equals types[T].cartan, adjacency equals types[T].adjacency, boardKind is 'gcm'; boardKind on every classification_tests cartan equals its components' kind where the board is connected (one-way for the one-way road, gcm otherwise); one_way_counterexample.cartan is 'one-way'; a hand-written not-a-board matrix is 'not-a-board'
property 1 with fast-check: mutate twice and fire twice are the identity on random vectors in [-9,9] on random types

labels.test.ts: a board constructed by hand with labels [0,1,2,3] (as an affine board will have) round-trips toLabels/toPositions and mutate on position 0 changes the entry the reader calls node 0 (guards E-7 against a stray +1)

overflow.test.ts: on the bigint_test board with SafeInt, replaying bigint_test.mutation_nodes throws EngineOverflow at the move after first_move_after_which_an_entry_exceeds_2_to_53 (determine the exact index semantics from verify.py and state them in a comment); with Big it reaches population_end
acceptance: GOLDEN_KEYS_BY_PHASE[0] keys all appear in coverage.json after the suite runs
all phase-0 golden tests pass for the 32 types (G0)
property 1 passes (G0)
labels and overflow unit tests pass
packages/engine has no runtime dependency (package.json dependencies is {}) and src imports nothing outside src
tsc --noEmit passes with strict
traps: C = 2I - A^T, not 2I - A: adjacency A[i][j] is roads from i to j; C[i][j] = -A[j][i]. Test with B2 where the matrix is asymmetric.

B_n has C[n-1][n] = -2? No: SPEC 2.8 says for B_n, C_{n,n-1} = -2 (1-based), that is C[n-1][n-2] = -2 in positions. For C_n, C_{n-1,n} = -2. For F4, C_{32} = -2. For G2, C_{12} = -3. Check every one against golden types[*].cartan.
SafeInt.mul must check the product, not only sums; 2^53 arithmetic: Number.isSafeInteger(2**53) is false.
fire changes neighbours by -C[j][i] * a_i, the column i of C; mutate uses row i. Do not transpose by habit.
The harness loads reference/golden_data.json by a path relative to the test file so it works from any worktree.

P0-A3.title: Mathematics rendering spike, KaTeX self-hosting, renderTex, names.mjs skeleton

spec: 7.3 (the <Tex> paragraph; the sources page paragraph; names.mjs)
owns: scripts/katex-assets.mjs (copies node_modules/katex/dist/katex.min.css and fonts to site/public/katex/)
scripts/names.mjs (skeleton: typesets the 32 type names and writes site/src/generated/names.json)
site/astro.config.mjs: the markdown section only (protocol: edit only the markdown/processor key)
site/package.json: the dependencies this spike decides (katex, and if route (a): @astrojs/markdown-remark, remark-math, rehype-katex)
deliverables: Spike A: a temporary .mdx page with $...$ and $$...$$ under processor: unified({remarkPlugins:[remarkMath], rehypePlugins:[rehypeKatex]}); build; inspect output for KaTeX markup and MathML; record versions actually resolved (katex via rehype-katex is ^0.16); confirm .mdx files pass through the processor (SPEC 7.2 item 1, [S2])
Spike B: a temporary .astro page calling katex.renderToString in frontmatter; build; inspect

Decision per the rule of 7.2 item 3: if both work, lessons use (a); <Tex>, names.mjs and sources.astro import the SAME installed katex that rehype-katex resolves; otherwise (b) with katex 0.19.x. Record both results and the installed katex version in decisions/P0-A3.md

katex-assets.mjs: copies CSS and fonts from the installed package into site/public/katex/<version>/ and writes the stylesheet link path; the base layout links it (coordinate with P0-A1's base layout by writing the link tag into src/layouts/Base.astro if it exists, else into index.astro's head; state which)
names.mjs skeleton writing site/src/generated/names.json with the KaTeX markup of the 32 type names (A_1 ... G_2); the full catalogue arrives in phase 6
remove the spike pages after recording results, or keep exactly one as site/src/pages/dev/math-check.mdx marked released:false
katex.test.ts: renderTex('\\alpha_1', false) contains <math and a katex span; the version in the stylesheet path equals KATEX_VERSION; a formula with an error throws
acceptance: decisions/P0-A3.md records both routes with evidence and the choice (G0: 'the rendering route is recorded in DECISIONS.md')
a built page shows the formula with JavaScript disabled, with MathML present (G0)
no KaTeX JavaScript is referenced by any built page (grep site/dist for katex .js)

Astro 7's default Markdown processor runs no remark or rehype plugins; the `processor` option of astro.config.mjs is where unified() goes (SPEC 7.2 item 1).

P0-A4.title: Content components G, Tex, Unverified, Cite; golden path resolver; unverified.json
P0-A4.summary: The four content components of SPEC 7.3 that make the content rules checkable by the build: <G> prints a golden value and fails the build on a bad path; <Tex> substitutes {{path}} and typesets with renderTex; <Unverified> marks or replaces a sentence by build mode; <Cite> links a SOURCES.md key and fails on an unknown one; lib/golden.ts implements the path grammar; content/unverified.json is seeded with E1 to E17 open.
spec: Appendix G (the path shapes used in examples)
golden: (read access to every key for the resolver tests; no comparison)
owns: site/src/lib/sources.ts (SOURCES.md key parser; used by Cite now and by sources.astro in phase 1)
site/src/lib/unverifiedRegistry.ts (collects <Unverified> usages during a build for the release report)
deliverables: golden.ts: resolveGoldenPath implementing: dot steps; key; key[index]; key[field=value;field=value] selection compared as text (lists of integers joined by commas); must resolve to exactly one value or throw GoldenPathError naming the path and the count; formatGoldenValue: integers with U+2212 minus and U+202F grouping in threes from five digits; lists in round brackets separated by commas; strings as they stand; as=word (labels separated by thin spaces U+2009), as=count, as=plain
G.astro: props k, as; renders the formatted value; a bad path throws at build time
Tex.astro: props src, display; replaces every {{path}} with the golden value (digits grouped with \\, inside formulas), then renderTex

Unverified.astro: props item (E1..E17 or later), fallback; reads content/unverified.json; preview build (RELEASE unset): renders children with a visible mark linking to /open-items#E4; release build: closed item → children unmarked; open item → fallback text, or nothing; registers usage {item, page} for the release report; never fails the build
Cite.astro: prop k; renders [k] linked to <base>/sources#k with the entry's first line as title; unknown key throws at build time
sources.ts: parses SOURCES.md for key definitions and their entry text; exports keys(), entry(k)
unverified.json: 17 items {id, status:'open', statement, whereToCheck, gate} transcribed from Appendix E with the gate of 9.1 that names each (6 → G2; 2, 3 → G3; 7, 9 → G4; the rest → G6)

tests: resolver on types.E8.weyl_order, satake[dynkin_type=E6;real_form=e6(-14)].dim_k, folding[type=D4;order=3].folds_to, wythoff[type=F4;rings=1,0,0,0].f_vector, positive_roots[0], a path matching two records (throws), an unknown key (throws); formatting of 696729600 and of -1 and of a list; Cite on W20 and on an unknown key; Unverified in both modes (set RELEASE in the test); a build-level check: a fixture page with a bad <G> path makes astro build fail (run as a script in CI or as a Vitest test spawning the build on a tiny fixture project)
acceptance: every path shape of SPEC 7.3 resolves in tests; the two failure cases throw with the described message
<Unverified> behaves as 7.3 in preview and release builds (tests for both)
<Cite k='Don08'/> links to the sources anchor; an unknown key fails the build (test)
unverified.json has exactly E1..E17, all open, each with the gate that names it
numbers printed by <G> use a true minus sign and narrow no-break spaces (test on -1 and 696729600)

A release build must never fail because of an open item (SPEC 7.3). It prints a report instead.

P0-A6.title: size.mjs, verify.mjs, numbers-in-prose.mjs, lab stub, npm command bodies, BASE_PATH test
P0-A6.summary: The repository's measurement and verification scripts of SPEC 7.6, 5.7 and 7.7, the bodies of the npm commands, the prebuild hook that runs names.mjs and katex-assets.mjs, and the browser test that builds with BASE_PATH=/sub/path/ to catch links typed with a leading slash.
spec: 7.6 (Measured by npm run size; lab timings)
golden: (verify.mjs compares the regenerated file with the committed one; no key comparison)
owns: .github/workflows/ci.yml (protocol: add the e2e, size and verify steps once their bodies exist; never remove a step)

deliverables: size.mjs: starts astro preview on site/dist (or takes a URL), opens every route of the built site at 360x800 in Chromium, waits for network idle without touching the page, collects every script URL fetched, gzips the corresponding files from site/dist at level 9, sums per route, classifies the route (no tool: 15 kB; the index page with one board: 60 kB; /tools/*: 90 kB; /modules/*: 120 kB; classification by data-tool count in the HTML and by path), prints the table, exits non-zero on excess

verify.mjs: runs `python3 reference/verify.py <tmp>`; fails unless exit 0; byte-compares with reference/golden_data.json; on difference also compares as parsed JSON and prints whether they are equal as parsed; prints the oracle's summary line; never writes into reference/

lab.mjs: in phase 0 prints 'lab timings arrive in phase 3 (P3-A7)' and exits 2; CI does not call it until phase 3
report.mjs: runs numbers-in-prose.mjs and copies the open-items report of a release build into reports/
